body.message:
Here is the letter to Faysal: 

our management agreement was formally terminated following my previous notice, as we did not reach a consensus on the revised pricing and terms. Consequently, the continued rental has been operating outside an agreed legal framework and below my expectations.

I am now finalizing a 12-month residential contract for Unit 2402 with an incoming tenant who is ready to move in immediately. Since the management contract is legally terminated, I count on your constructive cooperation to arrange a swift property handover:

Earliest Handover Date: Please assess relocating the current guest to another fäm unit or offering alternatives for upcoming bookings. What is the earliest date the apartment can be handed back vacant, cleaned, and with all keys and access cards?

Final Settlement: Please provide the final Statement of Account (SOA) and transfer any remaining rental proceeds and reserve funds to my account.
